subject: Mobile Development
title: The Trial That Shook Tech
description: A 60-second lesson on The Trial That Shook Tech.

hook.text: Epic vs. Apple went to federal court in May 2021. The entire tech world watched.

buildup.text: Epic argued Apple was an illegal monopoly. Apple argued the iPhone is a premium product, not a market.

discovery.text: Internal Apple emails revealed executives discussing how to keep the 30% rate defensible.

twist.text: The judge ruled Apple was not a monopoly but was anti-competitive on one key point.

climax.text: The ruling forced Apple to allow links to outside payment methods — a crack in the wall.

punchline.text: Not a monopoly, but not entirely fair either.

quiz.question: What was the key outcome of Epic vs. Apple?
options: Apple must allow links to external payment methods
